treatment.logline: A small roadside mishap brings a preoccupied pedestrian face to face with the attentive food vendor who retrieves her phone.

arc.beat: Occupied hands and an unnoticed loss
arc.feeling: Everyday distraction becomes a small vulnerability.

treatment.approach: Grounded Sri Lankan drama: ordinary physical awkwardness becomes a kindly first encounter. Four economical setups carry continuous action; the opening master includes the phone loss, followed by retrieval, Kasun's projected L3, and the answering turn and offer. Rain and restrained location sound remain, with no score; scoped silence is treated as musical silence, preserving the scripted line. No romantic embellishment or exaggerated chase.

colour_script.palette: Wet asphalt greys, muted roadside colours and natural skin tones.
colour_script.light: Overcast rain daylight, open roadside key with modest shade from the three-wheeler and umbrella.
colour_script.grade: Naturalistic restrained saturation and soft highlight roll-off; consistent throughout.

treatment.geography: Three-wheeler anchors screen left. Anudi travels left to right on the roadside, handbag on her right shoulder, umbrella in her left hand and phone initially in her right. Kasun starts beside the vehicle and follows rightward, retrieving the phone with his right hand. Anudi finally turns left; Kasun remains screen left facing her. Stay on the same roadside side of their travel axis.
treatment.key_image: Kasun's outstretched phone bridges the space between him and Anudi's umbrella, without a handover.
advice: Keep the phone visible against the wet road; no elaborate finger choreography.
End before Anudi takes the phone: that action belongs to the following scene.
Wardrobe and facial references must match the adjoining scene; no business-success polish at this early stall.

sequences.title: A missed pocket, a first encounter
sequences.purpose: Carry the loss, helpful pursuit and first face-to-face offer as one continuous roadside incident.

moments.what: Anudi passes the stall, attempts to pocket her phone, misses, and continues without looking back.
moments.feeling: Recognisable distraction; the audience notices what she misses.
moments.cut_uses: Side-on wide master, held still so umbrella, bag and falling phone share readable geography.

moments.what: Kasun spots the phone, retrieves it and hurries after her.
moments.cut_uses: Medium-wide roadside angle includes phone and Kasun's full bend and rise; one short rightward follow preserves urgency.

moments.what: Kasun gets Anudi's attention with L3 while holding her recovered phone.
moments.cut_uses: Kasun medium single from ahead on the same side of the axis, performing L3 with room around his right hand.

moments.what: Anudi turns; Kasun closes the remaining distance and extends the phone.
moments.feeling: Distraction gives way to direct attention.
moments.cut_uses: Held medium-wide two-shot allows the turn to precede the offer, ending with both faces and the phone readable.

editor_notes: The intended cut is approximately 17 seconds; the four raw takes total 18 seconds including handles, not a locked final duration.
3A-1 establishes the continuous walk, pocket attempt and fall; retain a clear view of the phone landing. Match its resting position to the opening of 3B-1.
3B-1 carries the practical retrieval and initial pursuit. Match the phone in Kasun's right hand, his rightward direction and pace into the complete L3 performance in 3C-1.
3D-1 answers the line with Anudi's turn before Kasun's approach and offer. Cut before any handover; the next scene begins with Anudi taking the phone.

Anudi retains her handbag on her right shoulder and umbrella in her left hand. Kasun starts standing with empty hands beside the three-wheeler; the exact initial posture and hand assignment are staging choices. Confirm wardrobe and faces against adjoining-scene references.

Scoped silence is interpreted as no score, not removal of the scripted line. Silent source takes can receive matching rain, traffic and practical effects in post; keep all background voices indistinct.
Speed ramp, freeze frame, digital punch-in and split screen are post-only options, not baked into the sources; none is required for this naturalistic cut.

Avoid fast pocket manipulation and bodily contact: stage the miss as a simple release, keep the retrieval readable, and leave clear space between the offered phone and Anudi. No mirrors or sharply rendered crowd are needed.
